Yes, that works and it's clear. Opening the "•••" menu and choosing "Move to Archive" took the A List Apart card out of my main list, bumped the Archive count up, and told me right there that I can restore it anytime — so I understood immediately that I'd set it aside, not thrown it away. That's the exact "tuck this out of the way but don't lose it" feeling I was after.

On your two questions: "Archive" is a fine name — it reads to me as "kept but out of the everyday pile," which is right. And tucking it into the little extra-actions menu suits it, since setting something aside isn't something I'd do constantly — I'd rather my main buttons stay for the frequent stuff and this live one layer in. Both choices sit well with me.

I'd want to look next at the archived things having their own place to live, and getting one back — but this marking part is clear.
